x: BRIGHTON FRONT - Fastest Times:- R.Holt (Herc) 12:17, R.Gevers (SLH) 12:20, L.Presland (Sy) 12:21, A.Maxwell (W.Gn) 12:21, C.Moxom (W.Gn) 12:23, J.Cooke (Portsmouth) 12:24
Bob Gevers and John Roberts struck a fine blow for South London by taking the first two places, with the Croydon pair of Don Faircloth and Fred Stebbings in the next two.
Competing in a composite team: W.Laws 16:04; M.Manning 15:22. Fastest laps: R.Holt (HER) 13:28; R.Gevers (SLH) 13:59; W.Upcott (SLH) 14:04 ... 5th fastest J.Stow (BEL) 14:06.

He was followed by that old warhorse Bob Gevers of South London, the 1987 winner. At M50 the Belgrave trio of Tony Stone, John Wasbrough and Tony Hardy, racing again after a long time out through injury, all packed well and finished within 15 seconds of each other.

Also to be seen are Chris Wade of Ranelagh (brother of tennis star Virginia), no. 11 Adrian Major (Belgrave) who placed 5th, no. 77, Mick Fuller (Hercules Wimbledon) and we can just spot Bob Gevers (SLH).
